record: AISEF V2.0 — the owner's stable release charter, machine-readable (charter §5). The verbatim text is authoritative; this record restates it for checking and never overrides it.
authority: owner charter 'AISEF V2 — STABLE RELEASE EXECUTION ORDER / OWNER RELEASE CHARTER / SCOPE FREEZE' (2026-10-03), docs/v2/V2-STABLE-RELEASE-CHARTER.md sha256 cd8833569fed317bb1ef20cb7bc997b6f7003218be1f5347bd53df001c04b58a
claims: AISEF 2.0 provides deterministic, evidence-bound orchestration and product verification for AI-assisted software delivery.
non_claims: FULL isolation against a malicious same-user host process
protection against a machine owner intentionally attacking the framework

candidate_code: MUST NOT control authoritative proof/verdict channels
threat_model.not_required: all six isolation properties FULL on every OS

all_of: a deterministic reproducer
affects the public V2 stable runtime, the shipped artifact, or an explicit V2.0 release claim
impact is one of the listed impacts
impacts: credential/security exposure in the shipped execution path
release_blocker_rule.otherwise: record it in V2.1-BACKLOG and continue the V2.0 release

G1.name: PRODUCT VEHICLE
all_of: package is aisef
version is 2.0.0
the aisef public CLI invokes V2 as the authoritative execution path
V2 code is included in wheel/sdist
no hidden/default V1 execution authority remains behind `aisef run`
G1.allowed: legacy V1 compatibility only as an explicitly named legacy surface, never as the default authority

G2.name: EXACT RELEASE CANDIDATE
G2.rule: no source change after RC freeze may retain the same RC qualification

G3.name: CORRECTNESS
on_exact_rc: Q0-Q5 GREEN on the exact RC
zero unaudited mutation survivors in changed release-critical code

G4.name: CI
G4.rule: exact RC CI green on every platform explicitly claimed; never claim a platform that is not green; a platform problem may narrow the support statement before RC freeze

G5.name: AUTHORITATIVE EVIDENCE
all_of: candidate code cannot manufacture or directly control the authoritative ProbeResult / verdict channel
raw authoritative run evidence required for release qualification is preserved
evidence identity binds the exact candidate/spec/probe/run identities required by current RFC semantics

G6.name: PUBLIC DELIVERY PATH
G6.rule: the canonical public workflow runs from a clean installed artifact (pip install aisef==2.0.0; aisef ...)

G7.name: FINAL LIVE RELEASE SMOKE
G7.judged_against: ABSOLUTE V2 acceptance, not V2 > V1
all_of: every planned story reaches a legitimate successful terminal state
100% mandatory release acceptance checks
100% mandatory V2 ProductProof for that workload
false acceptance = 0
framework-caused false rollback/block = 0
no identity stop
no budget stop
final artifact/workspace evidence preserved
G7.v1: informational only; not a release gate

G8.name: RELEASE MECHANICS
all_of: a TestPyPI or equivalent non-production artifact verification path exists
a clean environment installs exactly the built artifact
CLI smoke passes
package data is present
the release workflow cannot publish an RC merely because a generic v* tag exists
release conformance/freshness gates are current or explicitly replaced by this charter

G9.name: GOVERNANCE
all_of: the charter committed verbatim
a new append-only RELEASE-DECISIONS entry superseding the historical NO_GO for this V2.0 release process
historical NO_GO records never rewritten

deferred_to_v2_1: FULL hostile-developer isolation across all OSes
reconstructing every historical Owner ruling verbatim
broad branch-history archaeology not required for the release tree
witness-digest redesign where equal digest is legitimate content addressing and no integrity violation is reproduced

release_smoke.envelope: offline-rehearsal estimate + 25% headroom, never above the hard ceilings; no automatic expansion
release_smoke.on_fail: RELEASE_GO = NO, STOP, no further paid attempt, no fix-to-green; root cause to the owner

production_hold: no production PyPI publish and no final v2.0.0 tag before the owner's final confirmation

review_discipline.at_rc_qualification: at most two independent reviewers against this charter

prohibited_before_final_owner_confirmati: broad new mutation campaign unrelated to changed code
